newsitem.title: USA: GE appoints 3 finance vice presidents.
newsitem.headline: GE appoints 3 finance vice presidents.

text.p: General Electric Co said Monday it has appointed three vice presidents in finance.

Jay W. Ireland is vice president - finance for GE Plastics, located in Pittsfield, Mass. His position prior to this appointment was vice president - corporate audit staff. He succeeds Robert H. Brust, who left the company, it said.
Patrick Dupuis succeeds Ireland as vice president - corporate audit staff, located in Fairfield, Conn. His prior position was corporate staff executive for GE Vice Chairman Paolo Fresco.

Mark W. Begor is vice president - corporate investor relations. Begor is responsible for directing the company's communication with institutional and individual share owners. His prior position was manager - investor communications.
